title: The editor's info prompt skips fields
description: In the level editor, the player clicks Edit and the prompt asks for the level's name. Each Enter on a field that isn't empty moves it two fields on: from the name to the music, past the author; to the bombs, past the starting hearts; to the next level, past the ropes; and back to editing. An Enter on the emptied music does nothing.
